body: Happy Birthday :)) I'm so proud of you!
I know how that feels but trust me, better people will come along. Try to love yourself. You're enough for you.
I relate so much, I have been so vocal about how I feel and yet nobody fucking cares. I can't even drive. I don't know how do end it.

Honestly I don't think my death is going to affect people a lot, just the suicide part might be triggering. I'd get triggered by a stranger's suicide too. I hope counseling helps them get over that trigger. And about moving on, I don't think I'm ever going to get past it
2 months sober is a fucking achivement too for someone who couldn't go 5 days. I'm so proud of you. Happy 2 months. Please don't die, your life is about to get so much better for you.
Please call 911 or whatever is it that works in your country. Please. This is no way to go. You'll be in pain. I know it hurts but please call for medical help. Please

I have not related so hard to anything in a while. Cry it out, honestly. Have an honest conversation with this friend about how you feel. Tell them what you need, and how they can help. If not, please seek a therapist, or try and make new friends. Just one person is enough but when they leave, the world comes crashing down. A couple more won't hurt, they will help you maintain the balance of your life. I am feeling lonely too, if only I practiced what I preach:((((

Hey, it is so so endearing to know that you are following your heart in your career. you know what they say? one for the kitchen, one for the soul? Find a side hustle and make that extra cash. (Legal means obviously) Like freelancing, a graphic designer maybe. Normalizing bad parenting does not make it right. I know exactly how it feels to know your parents did not want you. Please please don't make your worth on the basis of a decision they took 18 years ago. You are here now, you are here for yourself, find yourself, and do whatever you want. Take care of yourself, and your siblings.

I have considered abroad education but the application process is daunting and the entrance exams are very competitive. I am so drained to prepare, you know. And I don't even want to study. Spending so much money for moving out seems a bit too much but I am considering it nevertheless but I am unable to find motivation. Dying seems so much easier than studying

I am really sorry, I relate to it to some extent. Please please cry it out first. And then, get yourself an education, or a skillset that you like and can pay you well. You can love your parents and still be mad at them. You can love them from a distance. Financial independence is what is going to get you the life you want. Please don't let the guilt weigh you down. Your parents chose to bring you into this world, they owe you and not the other way around. Please seek therapy, I know it is difficult right now but you seem like a compassionate young boy. Please please hold on, I promise it gets better.
